name: Daimiel (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, purple above and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Daimiel (a cross of Calatrava on white).
history: Municipal flag of Daimiel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Daimiel arms — cross of Calatrava on white
